description: Welcome to 18645 Hatteras St #285, a beautifully maintained 1 bed, 1 bath condo offering 758 sq ft in what may be one of the best condo complexes in all of Tarzana. This is not just buying a unit  it's buying into an incredible lifestyle and community. The resort-style complex features a sparkling pool, spa, sauna, gym, recreation/game room, gated guest parking, and multiple updated laundry rooms with over 10 brand new washers and dryers. The grounds are immaculately maintained, clean, lush, and beautifully updated throughout, giving the community a fresh and modern feel. Conveniently located near the freeway while still offering a peaceful and safe environment where residents enjoy walking both inside and around the complex day and night. An amazing opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors looking for one of Tarzana's most desirable communities.
